punchline: Julia Cameron tells blocked artists to draw their inner critic as a cartoon snake and put an X through it.
thirty_sec: In The Artist's Way, Julia Cameron calls the inner critic the Censor. Her advice: picture it as a cartoon serpent hissing in your creative Eden, or as the shark from Jaws. Draw it, cross it out, pin it where you work. Turning it into a nasty little character loosens its grip, and what it says stops sounding like the truth.
